items.source: Return whether this instance has expired depending on the amount of elapsed time since the call to startExpirationPeriod(int).
items.translation: 根据调用startExpirationPeriod(int)以来经过的时间量，返回此实例是否已过期。

items.source: A FlashMap can be set up with a request path and request parameters to help identify the target request. Without this information, a FlashMap is made available to the next request, which may or may not be the intended recipient. On a redirect, the target URL is known and a FlashMap can be updated with that information. This is done automatically when the org.springframework.web.servlet.view.RedirectView is used.
items.translation: FlashMap 可以配置请求路径和请求参数，以帮助识别目标请求。如果没有这些信息，FlashMap 将提供给下一个请求，该请求可能是也可能不是预期的接收者。在重定向时，已知目标 URL，可以使用该信息更新 FlashMap。当使用org.springframework.web.servlet.view.RedirectView时，此操作会自动完成。

items.source: Note: annotated controllers will usually not use FlashMap directly. See org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes for an overview of using flash attributes in annotated controllers.
items.translation: 注意：注解控制器通常不会直接使用 FlashMap。有关在注解控制器中使用闪送属性的概述，请参阅org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes。

The path may be absolute (for example, "/application/resource") or relative to the
current request (for example, "../resource").
items.translation: 路径可以是绝对的（例如，"/application/resource"）或相对于当前请求的（例如，"../resource"）。

items.translation: 启动此实例的过期周期。

items.source:
Compare two FlashMaps and prefer the one that specifies a target URL
path or has more target URL parameters. Before comparing FlashMap
instances ensure that they match a given request.
items.translation: 比较两个 FlashMap，优先选择指定了目标 URL 路径或具有更多目标 URL 参数的实例。在比较 FlashMap 实例之前，请确保它们与给定的请求匹配。
